# The no-hold taxonomy tests the accepted outcome's next step

## Context

The Engine companion of delivery ticket 1 ("Selection and continuation") of [D#19384](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19384), which reached quorum on 2026-10-03 with eight signals at body anchor `17:42:33Z`. Trace: D#19384 §3 mechanism I ("Taxonomy") and §4 ticket 1. The parent link to the Skills ticket of that contract is added when the planner files it.

Evidence, from the Discussion's census: 163 non-bot pull requests merged org-wide in three days; 132 closed a ticket their own author filed, and on 126 of those no second login had acted on the ticket before the PR opened; no FM v1 roadmap row moved.

## The Problem

§no_hold_state_taxonomy defines what "not holding" means for the §L3 block. It guards two loopholes, idling and collaboration as cover, and resolves both on one axis: "an activity is not-holding only if it advances a named lane". Two of its sentences rank shipping first: "Own PRs are **primary**; collaboration is a valuable *interruption* you return from", and the aggregate signal is own-ship-rate.

A lane the working seat names itself satisfies that warrant. The section therefore has no guard against the third failure the Discussion measured: shipping as cover for never finishing an outcome.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md:151–157` holds the section. It is tagged `[DISCIPLINE-ONLY]`, is Engine-owned, is not turn-loaded, and measures 2,217 bytes.
- Its per-turn entry is the last clause of the §L3 block ("both loopholes + detail in `§no_hold_state_taxonomy`"). That block is generated from the Skills package. The Skills half of ticket 1 rewrites it and has to keep the pointer; that is an acceptance criterion there, not here.
- ADR 0007 disposition: `rewrite`, plus `retire` for one clause. No new section and no new file.

## The Fix

Replace the section's text. The full replacement is in the Discussion reply [`18733859`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19384#discussioncomment-18733859), with the scope fold of [`18733889`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19384#discussioncomment-18733889):

- the warrant's question names the accepted outcome's next step;
- a third loophole, **L-ship**, stands beside L-idle and L-collab;
- the axis: an activity is not-holding only if it advances an accepted outcome's next unresolved step, and a new leaf its own worker filed is not accepted until a second mind accepts it;
- "Own PRs are primary" is retired, and the ratio signal reads outcomes moved against pull requests merged and threads opened.

The principle keeps its teeth-test shape. No list of valid activities is introduced.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The section states the warrant against an accepted outcome's next unresolved step and names three loopholes: L-idle (unchanged), L-collab and L-ship.
- [ ] AC-2 The clause "Own PRs are primary" and the own-ship-rate framing are gone. The second-mind sentence is scoped to a new leaf its own worker filed.
- [ ] AC-3 No enumeration of valid activity types is introduced, and the "NOT a closed list" sentence stays.
- [ ] AC-4 The section is not larger than today's 2,217 bytes.

## Out of Scope

- The §L3 block, `post-review-pickup` and the heartbeat clause in `AGENTS.md` (the Skills half of ticket 1).
- The wake directive and the idle-nudge texts (the Brain companion).
- The load receipt and the replay (delivery ticket 5).
- Any hook or lint.

## Avoided Traps

- **A closed list of lane kinds.** The section itself calls a list "the next weaponizable exit-set"; the Discussion retired that shape in v4.
- **Editing the generated `AGENTS.md` or `.claude/CLAUDE.md` copies.** They come from the Skills package.
